# Merchant underwriting

Merchant underwriting evaluates a merchant application and determines whether the merchant is eligible for card processing.
The process is performed by the Underwriting team.

1. Collect application — gather the completed application form and supporting documents from the merchant.
2. Validate application — confirm the business registration and the beneficial owners.
3. Analyze merchant risk — score the merchant against the risk model and review the industry category.
4. Make credit decision — approve, decline, or refer the application based on the risk score.
5. Communicate decision — send the outcome to the merchant within two business days.

Applications with a risk score above 80 must be referred to the credit committee.

# Glossary

Beneficial owner means a natural person who owns 25% or more of the merchant.
Risk score is the number produced by the risk model.
